info.name: HRMS API
info.description:
HRMS API — Admin + Employee (ESS).

Work module (matches UI): Shift Management, Shift Assignments, Work Timings, Weekly Off, Holiday Calendar.
Timing rules: early punch-in / late punch-out OK; Sat half-day (halfDayEndTime); Sun WO; holiday = HO (no punch).
official.shift only on Employee Management (HR/Super Admin/Global Admin) — not Access Control.

Auth: Login → Bearer {{token}}.

item.name: 0. Setup — Health & Login
item.description: Start here. Login as the role you want to test (token → {{token}}).

request.description:
Simple root check (no token).

Response:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": "ok",
  "message": "HRMS API is working",
  "name": "HRMS API",
  "version": "1.0.0"
}
```

Public health check — no token.
Checks API + MongoDB.

Healthy (200):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": "ok",
  "message": "HRMS API is healthy",
  "mongodb": "connected"
}
```

Down (503):
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "status": "down",
  "message": "MongoDB is not connected",
  "mongodb": "disconnected"
}
```

Global Admin — all companies (lean login account, no employee profile).
Sets {{token}} + {{userId}}.
Email: globaladmin@techculture.ai

Super Admin — own company (lean account: login + company only).
Sets {{token}} + {{userId}}.
Email: shivangi@techculture.ai

HR Manager — own company + employee profile.
Email: hr@techculture.ai

Manager — own company + employee profile.
Email: manager@techculture.ai

Sets {{token}} + {{userId}}.
Then use **Update Profile (Employee)** — personal only (phones etc). No official{}.
Clears httpOnly cookie `token`. Browser clients should call this on sign-out.

request.description:
No user id. Login token is enough.

Form-data:
- type = education | account
- document = file

Same type always saves in the same Cloudinary folder:
hrms/education or hrms/account.
Response url use on Submit (PUT /api/employees/:id):
- education → education[].document (url only)
- account → accounts[].attachment
